$comment: Tool layer of reviewNoVerdictRetry (scripts/conveyor/review-referral-hold.mjs#resolveNoVerdictRetry): standard 0 → platform → this file → env WE_REVIEW_NO_VERDICT_COOLDOWN_RELEASES, source logged by policy-cascade. cooldownReleases = bounded cool-down releases (1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 8h, 8h) for a head whose review verdict never landed, after the 2 immediate re-runs; integer 0..6, anything else is ignored. After the last release the hold is permanent (until a push or re-arm) and a needs-you event is raised per PR+head: AT-LEAST-ONCE by operator ruling 2026-10-20 (deduped in the normal path; a rare duplicate after a crash around publishing is accepted rather than ever staying silent). Operator 2026-10-20. OPERATOR RULING 2026-10-20 (#5765 bounded cool-down releases): 6 is the operator's ruled value, kept deliberately over main's 0 in the 1020c unfreeze; it is an operator ruling, not a weakening.
